meta.title: example.com Performance Audit
meta.headline: example.com: users are fine today, slow phones are not
meta.lede: Synthetic example data. Field Core Web Vitals pass; on a mid-range phone in the lab the page scores 52/100 and the hero image waits behind main-thread work.

field.note: URL scope, rolling 28 days. All three Core Web Vitals are good on both form factors.

labNote: Clean headless Chrome, cold cache, anonymous visitor. Mobile = Lighthouse default (4x CPU, 150 ms RTT, ~1.6 Mbps).

items: **No emergency.** Field p75 passes all Core Web Vitals.
**The bottleneck is the main thread.** About 70% of mobile LCP is render delay.
**Tags after consent** add about 600 KB and 5 s of CPU at 4x slowdown.
verdict.callout: Start with **P0-1** (critical CSS) and **P0-2** (delay marketing tags).

lcp.note: LCP element: hero `` in the first section. Ideal: TTFB ~40%, load delay <10%, load duration ~40%, render delay <10%.

findings.title: Verified: main-thread contention
findings.body: The hero image is in cache at 1.2 s but painted at 3.1 s; the carousel initializes later, at 4.0 s.

mainThreadNote: Lighthouse mobile, 4x CPU: 4.1 s in total.
thirdPartyNote: Main thread is measured in the consented state at 4x CPU.

waste.evidence: 140 KiB, 85% unused on this page, render-blocking

inp.note: Event Timing API, mobile viewport, 4x CPU.
diagnosis: Presentation delay dominates: style and layout over 2,800 elements.

memory.title: Memory: no leak
memory.note: Snapshots after load and after 10x menu + carousel cycles.
memory.footnote: Object ownership guesses are hypotheses until confirmed with retainers.

todos.title: Inline critical CSS and defer the rest
how: Extract above-the-fold CSS (at most 14 KiB) into an inline `<style>`.
todos.verify: Lighthouse mobile x3: render-blocking insight under 300 ms.

todos.title: Delay non-essential marketing tags until idle
evidence: Ad pixel A: 1.2 s main thread at 4x CPU.
how: Fire non-essential tags on a `page_idle` event.
todos.verify: Consented trace: third-party main thread under 2 s at 4x CPU.
